Create and Assign a Contract

User manual · English · 11 steps
Learn how to create an employment contract for an employee: give it a reference, assign it to the employee, enter the wage, save it, and start it.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Employees menu

Open the Employees menu.

3. Contracts

Click Contracts.

4. New contract

Click New to create a contract.

5. Contract reference

Type a reference for the contract, then press Tab.

6. Search the employee

Type the first letters of the employee's name.

ℹ️ Type at least three letters of the employee's name.

7. Choose the employee

Click the result you want in the list.

8. Monthly wage

Type the monthly wage, then press Tab.

9. Save

Click the save icon to keep the contract.

10. Start the contract

Click Running to start the contract.

11. Contract is running

The contract is now running. Click the contract name to finish.
